home.featureVerticalsDesc: Restaurant, Real Estate, Healthcare, Fitness, Education, Travel, Portfolio, Creative — each with market-specific data and features.

home.pipelineDescription: One prompt triggers a fully automated enterprise pipeline. No manual steps.
home.phaseMarketDesc: Industry benchmarks, competitor research & conversion drivers.
home.phaseRequirementDesc: NLP + AI prompt parsing into structured spec with implicit feature injection.
home.phaseStackDesc: Optimal stack profile per industry: React, Node, PostgreSQL.
home.phaseTrendingDesc: ROI-ranked feature injection: AI chat, loyalty, smart search.
home.phaseAssemblyDesc: Template + component + asset + backend selection from SQLite index.
home.phaseCodeDesc: Physical file assembly with AI customization and NPM auto-fix.
home.phaseQualityDesc: 6 enterprise gates: performance, security, features, assets, code.
home.phaseBenchmarkDesc: Industry comparison + launch-ready flag + ZIP delivery.

faq.q1: How does the AI build my website?
faq.a1: A 15-phase pipeline researches, designs, codes, tests and packages your site.
faq.q2: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a2: Yes — deployment configs and DNS instructions are included with every build.
faq.q3: Do I own the generated code?
faq.a3: Yes. Every build ships as a complete, self-hostable full-stack ZIP.
